title: Circular Motion in Speed, Time and Distance (Level 2)

questions.q_en: Three racers run on a circular track of 7 meter radius at the speeds of 2m/sec, 4m/sec and 11m/sec. If the bell rings at 12.00 PM when all the three racers are at the initial position, when would all the racers reach the finish line together for the first time?
questions.solution_en:
The speeds of racers are 2m/sec, 4m/sec and 11m/sec respectively.

The radius of the track is = 7m

Therefore the distance each runner needs to cover to finish the race = circumference of the circular track

Circumference of the track = 2 X 22/7 X radius = 2 X 22/7 X 7 = 44 meters

Time taken by each racer to finish race = (distance of track)/(speed of racer)

Time taken by individual racers are 22sec, 11sec and 4sec respectively.

Overall time taken until all the trackers finish the race together = LCM of time taken by each racer

LCM of time taken by each racer = LCM (22, 11, 4) = 44 seconds

So the final time when all the racers complete the race will be 12.00.44 PM.

questions.q_en: Two persons Arun and Varun started running around a circular track of length 400 m in opposite directions at speeds of 18 kmph and 27 kmph respectively. After how much time will the two meet for the first time?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed of Varun with respect to Arun = (27+18) = 45 kmph = 45 x 5/18 = 12.5 m/s.

Therefore time taken for the two to meet for the first time = 400/12.5 = 32 seconds.

Hence the correct option is (2).

Therefore time taken for the two to meet for the first time = 400/12.5 = 32 seconds.

Hence the correct option is (2).

questions.q_en: Karun and Nikita started for a car race from the same point, in the same direction and at the same time on a circular track of length 3270 m with the speeds of 80 km/h and 98 km/h, respectively. After how much time (in s) will they meet again for the first time?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed = 98 - 80 = 18 kmph = 18 x 5/18 = 5 m/sec

Distance = 3270 m

Time taken to meet again for the first time = 3270/5 = 654 sec

questions.q_en: Two runners, Abhishek and Pahul start running on a circular track of length 320 m at speeds of 16 kmph and 32 kmph, respectively, in the same direction. After how much time from the start will they meet again at the starting point?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by Abhishek to complete 320 m = 320/ (16 x 5/18) = 72 sec

Time taken by Pahul to complete 320 m = 320/ (32 x 5/18) = 36 sec

Required time = LCM of 72 and 36 = 72 seconds

questions.q_en: In a race around a circular track of 90 km, two cyclists are riding at a speed of 30 kmph and 15 kmph. After what time (in hours) will they meet at the point from where they started their journey?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by one cyclist = 90/30 = 3 hours

Time taken by other cyclist = 90/15 = 6 hours

Required time = LCM of 3 and 6 = 6 hours

questions.q_en: Two friends P and Q simultaneously start running from same point around a circular track. They run in the same direction. P runs at 13 kmph and Q runs at X kmph. If they cross each other at exactly two points on the circular track, then find the value of X.
questions.solution_en:
Ratio of the speeds = 13: X

When the runners are running in the same direction, the number of points where they cross other exactly = difference between the numeric digits of their speed ratio.

Here,

13 - X = 2

X = 11 kmph.

questions.q_en: M, N, and O run simultaneously, starting from a point, around a circular track of length 2400 m, at respective speeds of 5 m/s, 7 m/s, and 9 m/s. M and N run in the same direction, while O runs in the opposite direction to the other two. After how much time will they meet for the first time?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed of M and O = 9 + 5 = 14 m/s

Relative speed of N and O = 9 + 7 = 16 m/s

Net relative speed = 16 - 14 = 2 m/s

Time taken by them to meet for the first time = 2400/2 = 1200 sec = 20 minutes

Relative speed of N and O = 9 + 7 = 16 m/s

Time taken by them to meet for the first time = 1800/4 = 450 sec = 7 minutes 30 seconds

questions.q_en: Bhavesh and Pritam run a race of 20 km on a circular track of length 1800 m. Both complete one round in 180 sec and 240 sec, respectively. After how much time from the start will the Bhavesh meet Pritam for the last time?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by Bhavesh to complete 20 km or 20000 m = (180/1800) x 20000 = 2000 sec

So, the required answer will be less than 2000 sec.

Speed of Bhavesh = 1800/180 = 10 m/sec

Speed of Pritam = 1800/240 = 7.5 m/sec

Relative speed = 10 - 7.5 = 2.5 m/sec

Time taken by them to meet first time at the track anywhere = 1800/2.5 = 720 sec

So, the required answer will be the multiple of 720 that is close to 2000, and that is 1440.

Therefore, after 1440 sec from the start Bhavesh meet Pritam for the last time.

questions.q_en: In a high-tech 80 km circuit challenge on a circular loop track of 1200 meters, Vehicle A completes one lap in 300 seconds, while Vehicle B completes it in 360 seconds. If both start the race together, after how many seconds will Vehicle A cross paths with Vehicle B for the last time before the race concludes?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by vehicle A to complete 80 km or 80000 m = (300/1200) x 80000 = 20000 sec

So, the required answer will be less than 20000 sec.

Speed of vehicle A = 1200/300 = 4 m/sec

Speed of vehicle B = 1200/360 = 10/3 m/sec

Relative speed = 4 - (10/3) = 2/3 m/sec

Time taken by them to meet first time at the track anywhere = 1200/ (2/3) = 1800 sec

So, the required answer will be the multiple of 1800 that is close to 20000, and that is 19800.

Therefore, after 19800 sec or 5.5 hours from the start car A meet car B for the last time.

questions.q_en: Two persons started running on a circular track simultaneously with speeds of 48 m/s and 72 m/sec in opposite directions. If the circumference of the circular track is 240 m, then find at how many distinct points they will cross each other?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by them to meet first time anywhere at the track = 240/ (48 + 72) = 2 sec

Time taken by them to meet first time at the starting point = LCM of (240/48) and (240/72)

= LCM of 5 and (10/3)

= 10 sec

Number of distinct points they will cross each other = Time taken by them to meet first time at the starting point/Time taken by them to meet first time anywhere at the track

= 10/2

= 5

Time taken by them to meet first time at the starting point = LCM of (240/48) and (240/72)

= 10 sec

Number of distinct points they will cross each other = Time taken by them to meet first time at the starting point/Time taken by them to meet first time anywhere at the track

= 10/2

= 5
